GIVE THEM EACH THEIR OWN SPACE.
Lincoln Navigator is designed to help you provide your loved
ones with the support they need to flourish on every journey.
Start with the roomy leather-trimmed, heated 2nd-row bucket
seats that feature reclining seat backs, and add a 2nd-row
center floor console1 if you’d like.
PLUS, THE POWER TO ADAPT.
At the touch of a button, the PowerFold® 3rd-row 60/40 split
bench seat can be folded flat to make way for long cargo. In
its upright position, the seat treats your passengers to best-in-
class 3rd-row leg room, an added benefit of the independent
rear suspension.
AND PUT EVERYTHING IN ITS PLACE.
The long-wheelbase Navigator L provides you with a Cargo
Management System to help make the most of the 42.6 cu. ft.
of cargo space behind its 3rd row. Life is so much fuller when
you’re able to bring your loved ones and their favorite things
along for the ride.

Staying connected should be second nature. That’s the thinking behind the design
and high-speed performance of our SYNC® 3 enhanced voice-activated technology.1
Audio, phone, navigation and other features are concisely presented on the capacitive
touchscreen. Steering wheel-mounted controls and simple voice commands let
you place and answer calls, plus control music from your devices.
Seamless integration with Siri® Eyes Free brings the power of your paired iPhone®
into your vehicle. The Navigation System features easy destination entry and maps
with pinch-to-zoom capability, plus it makes it simple to find a new restaurant and
much more. With SYNC AppLink™, 2 you can use your voice to control some of your
favorite compatible mobile apps while driving, too. Automatic updates over Wi-Fi®3
help keep the system running at its best.
The 14-speaker THX® II Certified Audio System with patented THX Slot Speaker™
technology and specialized digital sound processing fills the cabin with studio-quality
sound, ensuring you experience music exactly as the artist intended.
Welcome to the World of SiriusXM.®4 Enjoy more than 150 channels including
the best commercial-free music, plus every major sport and the biggest names in
entertainment, news and comedy, with a 6-month trial subscription to the All Access
package included with your new vehicle. You can also listen online and on the
SiriusXM app.4 The Navigation System includes a 6-year prepaid SiriusXM Traffic and
Travel Link®4 subscription – the longest of any automobile manufacturer5 – that
gives you detailed traffic and weather information, fuel station locations and prices,
sports scores and much more.
Get more of your favorite music with HD Radio™ Technology. By broadcasting a
digital signal over traditional radio frequencies, HD Radio Technology gives you
up to 3 additional channels – per FM station – of new, local content. Plus, it can
display on-screen information such as artist, song title, album name and more.
And it delivers it all without the need for a subscription.

When you’re away, your Navigator patiently awaits your return, then welcomes you by illuminating your
path in the darkness.
As you approach, Navigator senses your key fob from up to 8' away and graciously casts a luminous
welcome mat with the Lincoln logo upon the ground beneath each sideview mirror.
Take your seat inside the cabin as the warmth of ambient lighting surrounds you, and Navigator adjusts
the sideview mirrors with memory to your personalized settings. It’s been expecting you.

From our trusted service advisors to our expert technicians to the
voice on the other end of the line should you call – we’ll be there
for you and your Lincoln wherever, whenever, if ever you need us.
Our Promise Includes:
PICKUP AND DELIVERY
We’ll pick up your Lincoln when it’s time for service, including your
complimentary first oil change, and deliver it back to you when
we’re finished.1 We’ll even provide you with a complimentary Lincoln
loaner to use while we have yours.2
LINCOLN CONCIERGE
Our caring agents are empowered to handle your call and concerns
from beginning to end. Contact us at 800-521-4140 or 800-232-5952.
ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE FOR LIFE
We’ll be there for you as long as you own your Lincoln – with
24-hour/7-day-a-week assistance nationwide.2
COMPLIMENTARY CAR WASH
After each service visit, select dealers are happy to return your
Lincoln to you washed and ready for the road ahead.2
COMPLIMENTARY LINCOLN LOANER
Should your Lincoln require warranty service, we’ll be there for you
with a complimentary Lincoln loaner vehicle.
BUMPER-TO-BUMPER WARRANTY
Be assured that your Lincoln is covered for 4 years/50,000 miles.3
